output.summary: KEP-583 proposed defining Coscheduling: a PodGroup-based API and scheduler behaviour so that all tasks of a job start together, implemented first out of tree in kube-batch via CRDs. Its status is provisional, and kep.yaml records it as replaced by KEP-4671 and KEP-5832.
output.rationale: Distributed ML jobs (TF/MPI) need all tasks to start together, otherwise jobs deadlock when resources are partial. The design proposed implementing coscheduling in kube-batch with CRDs rather than in k/k. Discussion mostly concerned the name: the community settled on "coscheduling" over "gang scheduling" and the design was deferred to 1.13 and then not tracked in the release.
output.outcome_reason: The sources say the KEP is replaced by KEP-4671 Gang Scheduling and by KEP-5832 Decouple PodGroup API, as recorded in kep.yaml. The sources do not explain why these replacements were made.

alternatives.why_not: Community discussion favoured 'Coscheduling' because the 'gang' term confuses users, though bsalamat argued for 'Gang Scheduling' and the team later chose 'coscheduling'.
Maintainers judged these too generic or to have conflicting meanings; bgrant0607 said 'group' is generic and 'aggregate' might be a better choice, but the team chose coscheduling.

alternatives.option: Land the implementation in kubernetes/kubernetes for 1.13
alternatives.why_not: k82cn said no k/k changes would land; the feature would be implemented in kube-batch and the design doc alone was committed for 1.13.

evidence.quote: we decide to implement Coscheduling in [kube-batch](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kube-batch) by CRDs.
we'll implement this feature in https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kube-batch/ for now. We only commit design doc here (1.13)
Yes, I think "coscheduling" is our best option for this feature
the term "gang scheduling" IS the established technical term for this feature and has been widely used for decades

supersession_claims.quote: KEP-583 is replaced by KEP-4671 Gang Scheduling
KEP-583 is replaced by KEP-5832 Decouple PodGroup API
